title: Emacs patch provenance contract

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: A patched Emacs build is a distinct runtime substrate whose source, patches, build flags, executable identity, and ABI surface must be recorded before its observability evidence is trusted.
hypothesis: The current development Insula should explicitly classify Emacs as stock. Any non-stock variant must carry patch and stock-comparison provenance in the plan or rootfs manifest.
minimal_fixture: The running Emacs binary and emitted `insula-plan.json'.
predicted_behavior: Stock Emacs passes with an explicit stock variant and no patch set; patched variants require source-pinned provenance and stock-vs-patched evidence.

independent_checks.name: stock variant has no patch set
patched variant carries source, build, ABI, and comparison provenance

counterexample: Using a locally patched Emacs binary because it has better traces can silently change the command loop, buffer machinery, redisplay, native-comp behavior, or ABI surface being benchmarked.
derived_gym_requirement: The Insula contract must treat patched Emacs as a named runtime variant and reject patched evidence that lacks source, patch, build, ABI, and stock-comparison provenance.
